findings.title: Associate captured Node Drag geometry with the validated Node, not caller map index
findings.specClause: Capture the declared geometry values once with their original receivers; validate and project those same captured values. Keep existing validation phase/order, malformed/canonical arrays and IDs.
findings.trigger: Two canonical Nodes [a,b], finite baseline/candidate positions and ordinary iteration; custom map returns the same canonical candidates but passes callback indices [1,0].
findings.actual: a receives b basePosition/position and b receives a geometry, despite successful per-Node validation; real Kernel View remains unchanged.
findings.evidence: Independent internal acceptInteractionProjection probe: ordinary control correct, custom-map strict assertion actualExit1 in spec-tests.log. Separately read real public SVG current2/2fail vs base2/2pass records using identical entrySHA381cbdd89bdb3af2b19ea0e54e523ac0a66c568b5b59f580ad11282abea53750.
findings.recommendation: Associate the captured geometry with its validated Node/candidate identity and resolve it during copying without trusting an application map callback index; preserve the approved array policies.

P2 — packages/renderer-svg/src/interaction-projection.ts:120–125：违反 “validate and project those same captured values”。验证按for-of顺序保存capturedPositions，却用应用map回调的index取缓存。canonical[a,b]、全部finite的合法候选，只让map传入互换index且仍输出[a,b]，就使a携带b的basePosition/position、b携带a的几何。本人使用真实Kernel baseline及规范Port/Session值的纯acceptor探针已重现：普通map控制正确；自定义map后a期望30/40却收到150/160，严格断言actualExit1。该探针是内部边界观察，不冒称公共Renderer/browser。另读取相同entry的公共SVG对照：base2/2通过、current2/2位置交换（非本人执行）。应按已验证Node/candidate identity关联捕获几何，不依赖调用方callback index，也不新增array限制。

其余字段捕获、有限值/正zoom/非负尺寸及浅metadata规则未发现独立缺口；HitResult.worldPoint补全符合公开契约，不能把fixture初次失败当产品修复。无另行scope creep finding。
